author: Inside Edition
description: These are weird burger stories! In 2019, a burger from In-N-Out ended up on the street in New York City, even though the burgers are found only on the West Coast. In 2016, a guy was nicknamed the real-life Hamburglar after making himself a snack in the middle of the night at Five Guys. In March, the McDonald's CEO was mocked after eating their new Big Arch burger on camera. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: A Real-Life Hamburglar And Other Weird Burger Stories
